name: scion-workbench
description: SCION Workbench enables the creation of Angular web applications that require a flexible layout to display content side-by-side or stacked, all personalizable by the user via drag & drop.

paragraphs: SCION Workbench enables the creation of Angular web applications that require a flexible layout to display content side-by-side or stacked, all personalizable by the user via drag & drop. This type of layout is ideal for applications with non-linear workflows, enabling users to work on content in parallel. Examples include business applications, scientific or development tools, and command & control interfaces.
